integrity: Theorem and bounds derived analytically. A standalone Python program checks exact interval integrals and directional derivatives; finite tests are not the infinite-dimensional proof. Previously established convexity and first-order characterization are acknowledged.
scientific_limitations: Exact threshold for fixed-mass vaccination measures under two strictly positive piecewise-constant seasons, constant waning rate and instantaneous log-dose convention; does not determine optimizer beyond threshold or nonlinear disease burden. No independent verification.
title: Exact pure-pulse vaccination threshold for two-season transmission
